Package com.mobybank.harness.domain

package com.mobybank.harness.domain
The heart of the harness: what a conversation is, and the rules that keep it consistent. Plain Java with no framework; the only imports are the JDK and this package itself, and a test fails the build if that changes.

What is here

  • Aggregates, which guard their own invariants and are saved as a whole: Session (owns its Messages and a status machine) and ConnectedFolders.
  • Value objects, all records that validate in their constructors: the typed ids (SessionId, MessageId, FolderId, UserId), file and step descriptions, ResultTable, SessionTitle and the requests and results exchanged with the ports.
  • Ports, the interfaces the rest of the app implements: SessionRepository, ConnectedFoldersRepository, SandboxAgent, SandboxTransfer and DocumentCatalog.
  • Events raised by aggregates (DomainEvent) and the DomainException family.

The rules worth knowing

  • A session is idle, running a turn, or moving, and only an idle one accepts a message or a move.
  • A move always goes to the other Location, which is what makes both local-to-cloud and cloud-to-local work with one method.
  • Aggregates are built by a factory (Session.start) or rebuilt from storage by rehydrate, never with new; they carry a plain long version for optimistic locking.

    Description
    AgentRepliedEvent
    Raised by a Session when the agent's reply to the running turn is recorded; messageId is that reply.
    AgentReply
    What the agent produced for one turn: its trace, the prose answer, and optionally a financial table.
    AgentTurn
    An immutable snapshot of one turn handed to the sandbox agent: where the session runs, the conversation so far and the new user message.
    CatalogFile
    A document inside a catalog folder.
    ConnectedFolders
    The document folders one analyst has connected, in the order they were connected.
    ConnectedFoldersRepository
    Stores each user's ConnectedFolders.
    DocumentCatalog
    The document source analysts connect folders from (OneDrive in production).
    DocumentSourceException
    The document source (OneDrive) could not be reached or refused the request.
    DomainEvent
    Marker for facts raised by aggregates.
    DomainException
    Base type for rule violations and port failures raised by the domain.
    FileRef
    A file attached to a message, identified by its name and where it came from.
    FileSource
    Where an attached file came from.
    Folder
    A document folder in the catalog that an analyst can connect.
    FolderId
    Opaque identifier of a document folder in the catalog (an item id when the catalog is OneDrive).
    InvalidMoveException
    The requested move is not allowed, for example moving a session to the location it is already in.
    Location
    Where a session's agent runs: a sandbox on the analyst's machine, or a sandbox in the cloud.
    Message
